correctness.rationale: The one-erasure criterion is derived from the signatures and proved necessary and sufficient. Exactly 2^20 masks are enumerated by verify_main.cpp with all 20 closed-neighborhood coverage and 190 separation tests. The complete histogram sums to 5945, its minimum degree is 12 with 15 optima, and comparison against independently generated C4 vertex patterns proves equality. S5 transitivity and exhaustive TAR BFS show the sharp budget threshold 15. Separately, verify_secondary.py checks all eight- and nine-omission subsets by direct deletion-and-signature semantics, reconfirming exactly 15 minima and no codes smaller than 12; it also independently recomputes the full histogram and TAR reachability over all 1,048,576 masks. Both programs executed successfully from their actual current paths.

originality.rationale: Exact four-cycle classification, all-weight polynomial and minimum-code TAR threshold were not located in inspected primary research or actual current research-record searches. Known two-domination/two-separation criterion and cubic lower bound already imply the scalar lower bound 12, which is expressly not claimed new. The earlier 20-vertex cubic census is a graph-class aggregate rather than a Desargues-specific optimum or connectivity classification. Distinct dodecahedral one-erasure results cannot imply incidence patterns on H(5,2). Publication priority remains provisional.
residual_risks: A later publisher-only error-detection study was available chiefly through its abstract; the full accessible 2022 error-correcting preprint clarifies that its variant imposes stronger constraints. A relevant dodecahedral result was accessible only via an indexed summary.
No online search establishes absolute priority; unindexed graph-specific tables may exist.
The result uses executable exhaustive finite proof, verified independently for the 12-sensor optimum but not by an external referee.

value.rationale: The canonical 20-vertex distance-transitive cubic incidence graph provides a natural finite test of maintenance-tolerant vertex identification. Beyond an already published cubic minimum lower bound, the exact 15-polygon geometric classification, complete 5945-state cardinality census and sharp three-spare reconfiguration threshold answer independent placement and transition questions; neither follows from the generic identifying-code criterion. The whole configuration family rather than an arbitrary small slice is classified. The connection between four-cycles of K5 and fault-tolerant sensor layouts is a mathematically motivated incidence-geometric structure.
